evidence.why: Shows the accessor assignment, three ignored helper results and complete utility arguments.

facts.rationale: Corrects the contradictory blanket claim that no called return values are consumed while preserving the established initialization data flow.
facts.value: Consumes the return from Ground_GetYakumonoParam by storing it in the file-local yakumono_param pointer. It then supplies IDs 0, 1 and 2 to grShrine_80201D20, ignoring each returned GObj, and calls Ground_801C39C0 and Ground_801C3BB4. Finally it passes the local vector {0.5, 0, 0}, selector -1, scalars 0.5 and 0, angle M_PI / 3, and bounds -10000, 10000, 10000, -10000 to lb_80011A50. Apart from the accessor assignment, calls are standalone statements whose results are not consumed.

evidence.why: Shows indexed setup and the complete constant-false body.
The installer consumes callback3, on_init and gobj_proc, but not callback1.

facts.rationale: Separates proven table membership and body behavior from the unsupported assertion that the shared installer establishes predicate dispatch.
facts.value: Its function pointer occupies callback1 in grSh_StageCallbacks[0], the row selected during setup of Ground object ID 0. If invoked, it ignores its Ground_GObj* argument, performs no calls or writes and returns false. The current Ground_SetupStageCallbacks implementation does not read or install callback1, so this setup path alone does not establish a runtime dispatcher or the provenance of an actual invocation argument.

facts.rationale: Corrects an unsupported runtime input-provenance claim without changing the supported row association or invariant result.
facts.value: Its function pointer occupies callback1 in grSh_StageCallbacks[1], the row selected during setup of Ground object ID 1. If invoked, it ignores its Ground_GObj* argument, performs no calls or writes and returns false. facts.rationale: Replaces the misleading 'no-return' characterization with the actual normal-returning void behavior and canonical slot type.
facts.value: A file-local ground-object event callback with signature void (Ground_GObj*), occupying callback3, the fourth function-pointer member of Shrine callback row 1. Its argument is unused; the empty body returns normally without a value.

evidence.why: Complete wrapper data flow and strict comparison.
Origin paths, parented-joint matrix setup and null-joint dereference of the local-point argument.

facts.rationale: Preserves the established origin-to-height-comparison flow while qualifying the overly broad claim of no caller-visible writes and exposing the helper's relevant input requirement.
facts.value: Reads the supplied fighter-position Y coordinate and obtains the reference joint's origin in a local Vec3 through lb_8000B1CC(joint, NULL, &b). It returns the strict comparison fighter_pos->y > b.y through the shadow-check interface and ignores the integer argument. The wrapper writes only its local temporary, but the helper invokes HSD_JObjSetupMatrix for a parented joint, so absence of all delegated joint-state effects is not established. A valid position pointer and non-null joint are required by this call pattern.

evidence.why: True only on greater-than; all other comparison outcomes take the false branch.
Relevant delegated matrix-setup and null-input behavior.

facts.rationale: Corrects the transitive no-mutation claim and records all outcomes of the strict comparison without inventing a stage state machine.
facts.value: For valid inputs, returns true exactly when the queried Y coordinate is strictly greater than the reference joint origin's Y coordinate; equal, lower and unordered comparisons return false. It has no local timer, persistent state or state-machine transition. Origin calculation is delegated and may perform joint matrix setup for a parented joint, so wrapper statelessness should not be interpreted as proof of no joint-state effects. The wrapper has no null guards.
